name: cctools-canton-network-daily-record
title: CCTools daily record of the Canton Network
description: One row per UTC day of Canton Network state, derived from Scan data served publicly by a Super Validator: rounds, issuance by category, supply, the SV reference price, Super Validators, featured apps and validator licenses. Every missing value has a reason in gaps.csv and every change after a value became final is in revisions.csv. CC BY 4.0 covers the daily aggregates CCTools derives and this documentation. They are derived from Scan data served publicly by a Super Validator; the host is named in the sources and on every value, and CCTools licenses only its derived aggregates, not the underlying Scan data.
rights: CC BY 4.0 covers the daily aggregates CCTools derives and this documentation. They are derived from Scan data served publicly by a Super Validator; the host is named in the sources and on every value, and CCTools licenses only its derived aggregates, not the underlying Scan data.

sources.title: Canton Scan (Splice Scan API) served by api.cantonnodes.com (Canton Nodes, powered by Proof Group, a Super Validator; a commercial service whose free tier is rate limited, with no published terms of service or data license)

fields.name: date
fields.description: UTC day D: the interval [D 00:00:00Z, D+1 00:00:00Z).

fields.name: status
fields.description: final, or provisional until the day settles.

fields.name: first_round
fields.description: Lowest mining round assigned to the day. A round belongs to day D when the record time of its AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing exercise falls in D (UTC).
fields.title: First round

fields.name: last_round
fields.description: Highest mining round assigned to the day. A round belongs to day D when the record time of its AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing exercise falls in D (UTC).
fields.title: Last round

fields.name: rounds
fields.description: Number of rounds assigned to the day, last_round - first_round + 1, checked for contiguity with the previous day.
fields.title: Rounds

fields.name: supply_cc
fields.description: Total Canton Coin supply at the end of the day (D+1 00:00:00Z): the Scan token registry's totalSupply whose totalSupplyAsOf is that instant.
fields.title: Supply

fields.name: net_supply_change_cc
fields.description: supply_cc(D) - supply_cc(D-1). Not issuance minus burn: minting is lumpy and burn can exceed it on a given day.
fields.title: Net supply change

fields.name: reference_price_usd
fields.description: SV-voted Canton Coin price (amuletPrice, the median of Super Validator votes) of the highest-numbered OpenMiningRound in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z. Not a market price.
fields.title: Reference price

fields.name: issuance_cc
fields.description: Issuance scheduled by the day's rounds: the sum of the seven category columns. Not minted supply.
fields.title: Issuance

fields.name: app_rewards_cc
fields.description: Featured-app reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalFeaturedAppRewardCoupons x issuancePerFeaturedAppRewardCoupon, as fixed at StartIssuing.
fields.title: App rewards

fields.name: validator_rewards_cc
fields.description: Validator reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalValidatorRewardCoupons x issuancePerValidatorRewardCoupon.
fields.title: Validator rewards

fields.name: sv_rewards_cc
fields.description: Super Validator reward issuance of the day's rounds: totalSvRewardWeight x issuancePerSvRewardCoupon.
fields.title: Super Validator rewards

fields.name: dev_fund_cc
fields.description: Development Fund share of the day's rounds: the amount of each UnclaimedDevelopmentFundCoupon created at StartIssuing.
fields.title: Development Fund

fields.name: faucet_rewards_cc
fields.description: Validator faucet issuance: optTotalValidatorFaucetCoupons x optIssuancePerValidatorFaucetCoupon. A measured zero while the faucet cap is 0.
fields.title: Validator faucet

fields.name: unfeatured_app_rewards_cc
fields.description: Unfeatured-app issuance: totalUnfeaturedAppRewardCoupons x issuancePerUnfeaturedAppRewardCoupon.
fields.title: Unfeatured app rewards

fields.name: unclaimed_rewards_cc
fields.description: Issuance not assigned to any coupon: the amount of the UnclaimedReward created at StartIssuing, read from its own event, never computed as a remainder.
fields.title: Unclaimed rewards

fields.name: super_validators
fields.description: Members of DsoRules.svs in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z.
fields.title: Super Validators

fields.name: sv_voting_threshold
fields.description: Votes a DSO action needs for that membership: ceiling((n + f + 1) / 2) with f = floor((n - 1) / 3), as Splice DsoRules.daml summarizeDso computes it.
fields.title: Voting threshold

fields.name: featured_apps
fields.description: Active FeaturedAppRight contracts in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z (contracts, not distinct providers).
fields.title: Featured apps

fields.name: validator_licenses
fields.description: Active ValidatorLicense contracts in the ACS snapshot at D+1 00:00:00Z. A new series: not the validator_count of Loop Data (formerly Lighthouse), by Five North.
fields.title: Validator licenses

fields.name: app_reward_coupons
fields.description: Featured-app reward coupons of the day's rounds: the sum of totalFeaturedAppRewardCoupons in each round's AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing summary. app_rewards_cc is each round's total times its issuancePerFeaturedAppRewardCoupon. A sum of coupon amounts, not a count of apps or transactions. Empty, as not collected, before the forward collector's first full day; the update-stream backfill is planned.
fields.title: App reward coupons

fields.name: validator_reward_coupons
fields.description: Validator reward coupons of the day's rounds: the sum of totalValidatorRewardCoupons in each round's AmuletRules_MiningRound_StartIssuing summary. validator_rewards_cc is each round's total times its issuancePerValidatorRewardCoupon. A sum of coupon amounts, not a count of validators. Empty, as not collected, before the forward collector's first full day; the update-stream backfill is planned.
fields.title: Validator reward coupons

fields.name: method
fields.description: Method versions of the row's values, joined by +.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Published revisions of the row's values since release.

fields.name: revised_at
fields.description: Time of the row's latest published revision.

fields.name: evidence_url

fields.name: date

fields.name: series

fields.name: new_value

fields.name: kind
fields.description: backfill, correction, withdrawal or method.

fields.name: reason

fields.name: revised_at
